note: Both sets read the wiring schedule rows correctly for the most part, but Set A binds more of the schedule's key details — ground conductor sizes for items 20, 50 and 34, conduit sizes for items 31, 34 and 50, and AL material for schedule 150 — which Set B omits. Set B does capture a few facts A misses (150's 2-1/2" conduit, 151's ARMORED CABLE type and 3#4/0 size, item 31's 2#10), but it twice stuffs the row's material 'CU' into a bogus conditions field and labels the attribute merely 'conductor', making those claims vague and mis-fielded. Set A's only real defect is one spurious condition 'C.' on item 34's conduit size, where 'C.' is just the abbreviation for conduit in the quote. Overall A is the more faithful and complete extraction.
